                                   Resolution 2023-09
                      Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors
                        RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT
 FOR INSTALLATION OF PERMANENT NO PARKING POSTS AND SIGNS AT VIRGIN CREEK
                    FALLS TRAILHEAD/TIMBERLINE ROAD

WHEREAS, Girdwood is a pedestrian-friendly community, with trailheads in neighborhood locations; and

WHEREAS, Virgin Creek Falls Trail has become very popular with people desiring a short and easy hike to a picturesque location;
and

WHEREAS, the volume of parking needed is not possible directly at the trailhead for Virgin Creek Falls, causing neighbors and the
Girdwood Valley Service Area to install informal No Parking signs to protect driveways, and road access; and

WHEREAS, this issue has been discussed previously on many occasions, resulting in a prior Resolution 2021-12 requesting
installation of permanent posts and No Parking signs in this location, which has not yet been completed.

THEREFORE, in order to provide for the needs of the neighbors and provide formal communication with trail users seeking vehicle
parking, the GBOS requests that No Parking Signage on permanent posts are place at the top of Timberline Drive at the Virgin Creek
Falls Trailhead.


PASSED AND APPROVED by a vote of 5 to 0 this 17th day of April, 2023.





Jennifer Wingard                                   April 19, 2023
GBOS Roads and Utilities chair                   Date
